tool_input.command:
mkdir -p submission
body=""
first=1
while IFS= read -r key || [ -n "$key" ]; do
  key="${key//[$'\r\n ']/}"
  [ -z "$key" ] && continue
  json=$(hops --quiet --json fv get profiles4857af_fv --version 1 --entry "account_id=$key" 2>/dev/null)
  vals=()
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    n="${line//[, ]/}"
    vals+=("$n")
  done < <(printf '%s\n' "$json" | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?,?[[:space:]]*$')
  if [ "${#vals[@]}" -ne 4 ]; then
    echo "WARN: key $key returned ${#vals[@]} numeric values: ${vals[*]}" >&2
  fi
  entry="\"$key\": [${vals[0]}, ${vals[1]}, ${vals[2]}, ${vals[3]}]"
  if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then first=0; body="$entry"; else body="$body, $entry"; fi
done < data/lookup_keys.txt
printf '{"vectors": {%s}}\n' "$body" > submission/answers.json
echo "=== DONE ==="
cat submission/answers.json
tool_input.description: Loop online lookups and build answers.json
